segments.text: Good morning and thanks everyone for joining us today.

segments.speaker_name: commerce at an extraordinary scale flowing through the platform
segments.text: We've got another exceptional quarter to talk about here at Shopify.

segments.speaker_name: commerce at an extraordinary scale flowing through the platform
segments.text: Here's what that looks like in the numbers.

segments.speaker_name: commerce at an extraordinary scale flowing through the platform
segments.text: GMD was up 32% to $116 billion with broad growth across our merchant sizes, geographies,

segments.speaker_name: commerce at an extraordinary scale flowing through the platform
segments.text: and sales channels.

segments.speaker_name: commerce at an extraordinary scale flowing through the platform
segments.text: Our revenue was up 34% to $3.6 billion and our free cash-in margin was 18%.

segments.speaker_name: commerce at an extraordinary scale flowing through the platform
segments.text: That's a growth rate of 30% or more across every metric.

segments.speaker_name: commerce at an extraordinary scale flowing through the platform
segments.text: And this marks our fifth straight quarter of GMD growth above 30%.

segments.speaker_name: commerce at an extraordinary scale flowing through the platform
segments.text: Now of all the numbers, our GMD is the one worth repeating.

segments.speaker_name: commerce at an extraordinary scale flowing through the platform
segments.text: Our merchants processed $116 billion this quarter.

segments.speaker_name: commerce at an extraordinary scale flowing through the platform
segments.text: This is commerce at an extraordinary scale flowing through the platform.

segments.text: And it also tells us that our merchants are thriving.

segments.text: quarter after quarter,

segments.text: in this new era of commerce.

segments.text: First, our addressable market of most merchants

segments.text: Because we've made it easier to start,

segments.text: there are now simply more merchants to serve,

segments.speaker_name: commerce at an extraordinary scale flowing through the platform
segments.text: and the breadth of our capabilities has expanded

segments.speaker_name: commerce at an extraordinary scale flowing through the platform
segments.text: so that merchants of all sizes now run on Shopify.

segments.text: Second, the range of those, most of the time,

segments.speaker_name: commerce at an extraordinary scale flowing through the platform
segments.text: merchant needs is expanding quickly.

segments.text: They need access to new and emerging surface areas.

segments.text: They need best-in-class tools

segments.text: that will allow them to keep pace with the rate of change.

segments.text: best-in-class tools that will allow them to keep pace

segments.speaker_name: commerce at an extraordinary scale flowing through the platform
segments.text: for a simple unified platform that they can rely on.

segments.text: Our open ecosystem model is uniquely well-suited

segments.text: while making the platform extensible for everything else.

segments.text: and we let the best developers and the best companies

segments.text: in the world build on top of us.

segments.text: In the last year, we kicked that model

segments.text: into a whole new gear.

segments.text: Some of the largest technology companies in the world,

segments.text: like OpenAI, Google, Meta, and Microsoft,

segments.speaker_name: commerce at an extraordinary scale flowing through the platform
segments.text: have chosen to partner with us

segments.speaker_name: commerce at an extraordinary scale flowing through the platform
segments.text: to open more front doors for commerce.

segments.speaker_name: commerce at an extraordinary scale flowing through the platform
segments.text: Every new surface area they build

segments.speaker_name: commerce at an extraordinary scale flowing through the platform
segments.text: is another place our merchants can sell

segments.speaker_name: commerce at an extraordinary scale flowing through the platform
segments.text: all because they're on Shopify.

segments.text: And on top of this, thousands of developers

segments.speaker_name: commerce at an extraordinary scale flowing through the platform
segments.text: all over the world are embedding.

segments.text: Thousands of developers all over the world are embedding commerce into their own applications

segments.text: using the same primitives we built.

segments.speaker_name: commerce at an extraordinary scale flowing through the platform
segments.text: Thousands of new front doors all built on one unified foundation, the Shopify platform.

segments.text: Now, as commerce continues to fragment, Shopify becomes an even more critical partner

segments.speaker_name: commerce at an extraordinary scale flowing through the platform
segments.text: because we provide consistent and reliable infrastructure

segments.speaker_name: commerce at an extraordinary scale flowing through the platform
segments.text: that makes every shopping experience feel seamless.

segments.speaker_name: commerce at an extraordinary scale flowing through the platform
segments.text: Now, whether commerce is handled by humans or agents,

segments.speaker_name: commerce at an extraordinary scale flowing through the platform
segments.text: whether stores are built by people or AI,

segments.speaker_name: commerce at an extraordinary scale flowing through the platform
segments.text: Shopify runs underneath it all.

segments.speaker_name: commerce at an extraordinary scale flowing through the platform
segments.text: For 20 years, we've built the commerce operating system

segments.speaker_name: commerce at an extraordinary scale flowing through the platform
segments.text: that takes merchants from first sale to full scale

segments.speaker_name: commerce at an extraordinary scale flowing through the platform
segments.text: by using our partner ecosystem as an extension of our platform.

segments.speaker_name: commerce at an extraordinary scale flowing through the platform
segments.text: That is our muscle memory.

segments.speaker_name: commerce at an extraordinary scale flowing through the platform
segments.text: And this model will continue to service even better in this new agentic era of commerce.

segments.text: So let's talk more about Shopify's infrastructure,

segments.speaker_name: commerce at an extraordinary scale flowing through the platform
segments.text: specifically what we've been building and why it matters so much.

segments.text: We have a very strong conviction that commerce experiences will soon...

segments.text: be built in to

segments.speaker_name: commerce at an extraordinary scale flowing through the platform
